AUTH_FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
AUTH_INVALID_API_KEY: The API key is not valid.
AUTH_API_KEY_READ_ONLY: This API key can only read, not change anything.
GUILD_ACCESS_DENIED: You do not have permission to manage this server.
GUILD_BOT_MISSING: The bot is not in this server.
DISCORD_API_ERROR: Discord returned an error. Please try again later.
DISCORD_MISSING_PERMISSIONS: The bot cannot {permission, select, view {view this channel} send {send messages in this channel} other {use this channel}}. Grant it that permission and try again.
DISCORD_CHANNEL_NOT_FOUND: Channel not found, or the bot cannot access it.
VALIDATION_FAILED: Some values are not valid. Check what you entered and try again.
SCHEDULE_LIMIT_REACHED: This server already has the maximum number of scheduled messages waiting. Cancel some or wait for them to be sent.
SCHEDULE_TOO_FAR: That time is too far ahead. Choose an earlier time.
MESSAGE_TOO_LONG: The message is longer than 2000 characters, which the bot cannot send.
ATTACHMENTS_TOO_LARGE: The files are larger than the destination server accepts.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

invalidLink.EMPTY: Provide a message link. Right-click a message and choose Copy Message Link.
invalidLink.MALFORMED: That is not a message link. Right-click a message and choose Copy Message Link.
invalidLink.CHANNEL_REQUIRED: A message id alone is not enough here. Paste the full message link.
